dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: AI-powered restaurant marketing on the go.
dashboard.headline: Run campaigns from anywhere
dashboard.lead: AI turns your sales data into Instagram campaigns—built for busy floors, not just desks.

apps.title: Apps
apps.description: Loyalty apps that own customer registrations for this workspace.
apps.emptyDescription: Create an app to start enrolling customers for marketing programs.
apps.deleteConfirmDescription: This permanently removes “{title}”. This cannot be undone.
apps.appIdHelp: Public identifier used in enrollment links and the mobile app. It cannot be changed.
apps.cashbackSectionHelp: When a payment meets the threshold, this percentage is recorded as cashback.
apps.cashbackThresholdHelp: Minimum payment amount in Indonesian Rupiah before cashback applies. Use 0 to disable by amount.
apps.cashbackPercentHelp: Whole-number percent from 0 to 100. Example: 20 means 20% of the payment.

detail.title: App details
detail.description: Update the app title and cashback rule used across CRM registrations.

registrations.title: Registrations
registrations.description: Customers enrolled in the selected app for marketing programs.
registrations.appDescription: Registrations are scoped to the selected app.
registrations.selectApp: Select an app to view registered customers.
registrations.emptyDescription: Enroll customers by generating a one-time QR code they can scan in the restaurant.
registrations.noApps: Create an app before managing customer registrations.
registrations.dialogDescription: Customer scans this code (or pastes the link) in the mobile app within 5 minutes.
registrations.expired: This code has expired. Generate a new one.
registrations.awardCashbackDescription: Award from a payment total using this app’s threshold and percent, or redeem from the customer’s balance.
registrations.cashbackHistoryEmpty: No cashback yet — awards and redemptions will appear here.
registrations.awardPaymentHelp: Must meet the payment threshold to earn cashback.
registrations.awardPreviewBelowThreshold: Payment is below the threshold of {threshold}. No cashback yet.
registrations.awardPreviewZero: Configured percent yields no cashback for this payment.
registrations.awardRedeemHelp: Deducts this amount from the customer’s cashback balance.
registrations.awardLabelPlaceholder: e.g. Table 4 visit or Redeemed at till
registrations.awardLabelHelp: Optional note shown in the customer’s cashback history.
registrations.awardAmountHelp: Use a minus sign to subtract from the balance.
registrations.deviceRevokeConfirmDescription: The device will lose access immediately and must re-enroll to sign in again.
registrations.deleteConfirmDescription: This permanently removes {phone} and their enrolled devices. This cannot be undone.
